title: One app. Three roles. Everyone in the picture.
lead: Each role gets its own screens, built around its day: the owner dashboard, the teacher app and the parent app.

roles.heading: See the whole nursery at a glance
roles.imageAlt: The owner dashboard: a daily attendance chart and recent activity feed.
items: See today's children, teachers and incidents on one dashboard.
Manage rooms, capacity, schedules and which teacher is where.
Send announcements and events to a room or the whole nursery.
Review attendance and incident logs, export your records, and set opening hours and how close parents must be to check in.

roles.heading: Your room, in your hand
roles.imageAlt: The teacher app: a child's daily log with mood, meals, nap, nappy and activity, and Save Draft and Publish buttons.
items: Open your room and see who is in, not arrived or absent. Mark a child in by hand.
Log mood, meals, nap, nappies, activities and medication. Save drafts and publish.
Share photos with one child or the whole room.
Write an incident report in a minute, message parents and post announcements.

roles.heading: Their day, in your pocket
roles.imageAlt: The parent app home: the week strip, check-in status and today's schedule.
items: Check in and out from the gate, and see attendance history.
See the day: mood, meals, nap, schedule and photos.
Message the nursery, read announcements and save events.
Keep your child's profile up to date: allergies, immunisations, who may collect them, and your quiet hours.
